entities.summary: Manu Joseph is an Indian journalist and writer. He is the former editor of Open magazine. His first debut novel Serious Men (2010) won The Hindu Literary Prize and the PEN Open Book Award and was later adapted as a film of the same name. His second novel, The Illicit Happiness of Other People (2012) was shortlisted for The Hindu Literary Prize in 2013.
